name: backend
description: Welcome to developer word, this is the backend of the project. Here we will be using Node.js and Express.js to create our server and handle API requests. We will also be using MongoDB as our database to store user data and other information. Developer Jitendra Kumar is the main developer of this project, and he has been working hard to create a robust and efficient backend for our application. We will be implementing various features such as user authentication, data validation, and error handling to ensure that our backend is secure and reliable. Stay tuned for more updates on the development of our backend!
author: Jitendra Kumar
